author: acceptance_review
confirmed_behavior: Exception or KeyboardInterrupt in actual seal/verify produces final failed/2/unsealed_finalization_error with phase/type/message.
One exclusive pre-seal report copy retains bytes submitted to failed seal before changing final report. Existing backup is never overwritten or numbered into a retry series.
Any written seal remains untouched, described as failed attempt; no inventory omissions, file deletion, re-seal or automatic retry.
A secondary failure fingerprinting the original seal records unavailable diagnostics and still persists a writable failed report.
If retaining/updating failure metadata is impossible, CLI2 with explicit stderr preserves available originals without claiming their pre-seal success became final.
Stopped successful observations still seal0; stopped ordinary unequal parity observations retain original failure seal1; live-owned-writer branch remains unsealed.

earlier_exploration.scope: Early directory named before-m5 actually recorded author v1 hash354069, not M5; original outputs kept unchanged. Formal baseline/candidate records use distinct fixed directories and exact source hashes.

fault_cases: real original seal followed by inventory addition
independent_validation.synthetic_control_scope: Tiny actual stdio driver/main, mocked build admission and synthetic executable fixtures. Not native M5 acceptance or repeated original observations.

limits: This metadata fix does not identify or stop the filesystem writer that caused original M5 mixed or peer scale failures.
